name: Quick Tomato Noodle Soup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 packages instant ramen or udon noodles with flavoring mix

steps: Bring 1.5 L of water to a boil.
Add noodles to to boiling water with one of flavoring packets.
Add chopped tomatoes and sausages. Boil for 5 minutes.

culture.text: Noodle soup refers to a variety of soups with noodles and other ingredients served in a light broth. Noodle soup is a common dish across East Asia, Southeast Asia and the Himalayan states of South Asia. Various types of noodles can be used.
